build_audio_tokenizer: build a MiMoAudioTokenizer from a config to encode mel spectrograms into discrete audio codes
encode_audio_batch: encode a batch of mel spectrograms into audio codes using the audio tokenizer encoder
tokenize_audio_batch: tokenize multiple mel spectrograms into discrete audio codes using the tokenizer encoder
build_audio_encoder: build a MiMoAudioEncoder that processes mel features through speech embeddings and a Qwen2 transformer
configure_audio_encoder: configure a MiMoV2AudioConfig with speech vocab sizes, delay patterns, and local transformer settings
